steps.observation: You have 30 seconds. Explain the difference between RNA and DNA.

steps.action:
DNA and RNA differ in four key ways:

1. Sugar  
   • DNA: deoxyribose (lacks an OH on the 2′ carbon)  
   • RNA: ribose (has a 2′-OH)

2. Bases  
   • DNA: adenine (A), thymine (T), guanine (G), cytosine (C)  
   • RNA: adenine (A), uracil (U) replaces T, guanine (G), cytosine (C)

3. Structure  
   • DNA: usually a stable, double-stranded helix  
   • RNA: usually single-stranded, can fold into complex shapes

4. Function & Location  
   • DNA: stores and transmits genetic information in the nucleus (and mitochondria)  
   • RNA: carries and helps translate genetic messages (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA), works mainly in the cytoplasm and ribosomes
